howtos.title: Have an agent audit every code comment
howtos.what: Matt Pocock's prompt of the day: an agent reviews each code comment and sorts it by category.
copy: Ask the agent to review every code comment in the codebase, or in one section of it.
First category: tautology, a comment that repeats what is already visible in the code.
howtos.whenToUse: When a codebase has collected noisy or outdated comments and you want a quick cleanup pass.
